## Traceability chain for %CAR+

**Bottom line:** %CAR+ is measured by the validated flow method FC-CAR (% of CD3+) and has a release/PPQ criterion of ≥20%. The process is controlled mainly through transduction MOI, which is the strongest driver in the data. PPQ passed comfortably (36–45%). The open issues are that the highest-RPN CAR risk (FM-06) has no assurance approach or CAR-specific test linked, the root cause of the low engineering runs is unresolved and probably mis-attributed, and an open change control (CC-26-022) would move MOI outside the validated range.

### 1. Definition and measurement
- **CQA:** %CAR+ (FC-CAR, % of CD3+), PPQ-001 criterion 8, ≥20%. Complementary CQAs are VCN per CAR+ cell (≤5 copies, criterion 9, ddPCR per URS-LIMS-004) and ID-CAR-PCR (positive).
- **Method:** AM-FC-CAR, flow cytometry, validated range 5–90% of CD3+. Validation protocol AMV-FC-CAR-01 (v1.0) is approved; its single test case TC-AMV-CAR-01 was executed as TX-0086 on 2026-03-20 (PASS, VAL-03/QA-02). The acceptance criterion is recorded only as "per ICH Q2(R2) protocol criteria", with no numeric limits.
- **In-process:** %CAR+ is also recorded on expansion day 5 (uo05 car_pos_pct), but only on that day.

### 2. Process parameters driving %CAR+
- **Transduction MOI** (CPP, 4.0–6.0 TU/cell, PPQ-001 criterion 1; enforced by hard stop URS-EBR-009 / CS-EBR-03; calculation URS-EBR-007 / CS-EBR-02; procedure SOP-MFG-104 v2.0). Observed FC-CAR by MOI, from DoE and platform runs:
  - MOI 2.5: 19.4 and 23.8%
  - MOI 5.0 (PV2.0, excluding ENG): about 35–45%
  - MOI 10: 64.8 and 68.2%
  - MOI 15: 76.3 and 77.1%
  - There are no data at MOI 4.0, the lower edge of the CPP range.
- Other CPPs: seeding density 0.4–0.6 ×10⁶/mL (crit 2), incubator temperature 36.5–37.5 °C (crit 3), culture duration 7–9 days (crit 4), activation-to-transduction time 20–30 h (crit 5).
- Upstream: CD3 selection program and purity (FM-02, URS-PRDG-002), wash loss at harvest (FM-12), vector storage (FM-07).

### 3. Risks threatening %CAR+ (RA-PFMEA-001 v2.0, 2026-04-28)
| Risk | Failure mode | RPN / class | Current controls | Linked requirements | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FM-06 | MOI below target (cause: titer over-estimated, vector degradation) | 128 / HIGH (highest CAR-related) | EBR calculation; CoA titer | URS-EBR-007, SOP-MFG-104 | Assurance approach blank; no CAR test or URS-EBR-009 link; relies on CoA titer |
| FM-15 | OOS not flagged at QC release (affects %CAR+, VCN, viability, CD3) | 80 / HIGH | LIMS validation; second-person review | URS-LIMS-002, -003 | Assurance approach blank |
| FM-12 | Excess cell loss at wash | 54 / MEDIUM | LOVO OQ/PQ | URS-LOVO-001 | Indirect effect on CAR+ dose only |
| FM-11 | Harvest outside day 7–9 | 24 / LOW | Batch record | SOP-MFG-106 | Low rating |

FM-05 (MOI above target) threatens VCN rather than %CAR+. The pFMEA has no failure mode for low CD3 at apheresis, so the donor pathway suggested by DEV-26-027 is not covered by a risk item. All assurance-approach fields in the rows I reviewed are blank.

### 4. Performance in engineering and PPQ
- **Engineering runs (PV2.0, MOI 5.0, LV25-118 vector lot):** ENG26-01 19.8%, ENG26-02 11.9%, ENG26-03 13.9%. All were flagged NONCONFORMING (INFO) against the 20% target. The day-5 values were 5.5–12.2%.
- **PPQ (PV2.0, PPQ-001 execution complete, report pending):** PPQ26-01 to -05 gave 44.6, 39.2, 36.1, 38.9 and 37.3% (mean 39.2%), all PASS. VCN was 1.79–2.39 copies/CAR+ cell, all PASS. MOI was 5.0 for all five, and transduction timing was 21.9–23.7 h. PPQ-001 has no linked test cases.
- PPQ26-02 harvest viability was 73.4% (below the 80% criterion). This was a separate, closed deviation and did not affect %CAR+.

### 5. Deviations, CAPAs and change controls
- **DEV-26-027 (MINOR, OPEN):** low %CAR+ in ENG26-01 and ENG26-02. The recorded root cause is donor variability (low CD3 at apheresis). This looks unsupported:
  - The ENG donors' apheresis CD3 was 65.3%, 63.8% and 50.9%, within the range of other runs.
  - PD26-041 had 31.7% CD3 at apheresis and still reached 37.0%.
  - All three ENG runs used vector lot LV25-118 (CoA functional titer 104 M TU/mL). Every subsequent MOI-5 run with LV26-007 or LV26-021 gave 35–45%, including PD26-028 with the same enhancer lot (VF-2602).
  - LV25-118 is the only reagent that distinguishes the failing runs. Its titer is about 24% below LV26-007, which is a plausible contributor under FM-06, but the 2–3× drop is larger than titer alone would predict, so this is a hypothesis to test.
  - DEV-26-027 links only ENG26-01 and ENG26-02, not ENG26-03 (13.9%), and does not link the vector lot.
  - It is linked to CAPA-26-016 (evaluate minimum CD3% at receipt, due 2026-09-30, OPEN), which addresses the donor hypothesis only.
- **DEV-26-033 (MAJOR, CLOSED):** PPQ26-02 viability failure caused by an incubator door not latched (INC-03). Its effect on %CAR+ was negligible. CAPA-26-015 is closed, but effectiveness check is PENDING.
- **DEV-26-041 (MINOR, OPEN):** tubing leak in PPQ26-05 before product contact. Linked to CAPA-26-019 (supplier CAPA, OPEN). No CAR effect.
- **CC-26-004 (closed 2026-05-01):** PV2.0 process change, which impacts RA-PFMEA-001.
- **CC-26-022 (IMPACT ASSESSMENT, OPEN):** proposes raising target MOI from 5.0 to 8.0 TU/cell to increase %CAR+. Concerns:
  - 8.0 is outside the validated 4.0–6.0 range and the EBR hard stop, so PPQ-001 criterion 1, URS-EBR-009 and CS-EBR-03 would all need revision.
  - VCN already rose to 3.0–4.8 at MOI 10–15 (limit ≤5). MOI 8 has not been tested.
  - The change is linked only to SOP-MFG-104. It is not linked to RA-PFMEA-001 or FM-05/FM-06.

### 6. Gaps to close
1. Add an assurance approach and link FM-06 to a CAR-specific control (in-process %CAR+ gate, FC-CAR test evidence, and URS-EBR-009). Also link FM-15 to the FC-CAR release test.
2. Re-open the DEV-26-027 root-cause investigation to test LV25-118 functional titer and vector handling. Include ENG26-03 and retarget CAPA-26-016 accordingly.
3. Complete the PPQ-001 report and link its test cases. Characterize MOI at 4.0 (the lower CPP limit), which the data do not cover.
4. Do not progress CC-26-022 until MOI 8 is assessed against VCN, the EBR range, and the pFMEA.
5. The acceptance criterion in TC-AMV-CAR-01 is not numeric and should be specified. No URS or spec item for %CAR+ itself was found; the only links are the MOI range and the release tests.

content.text:
## Traceability chain for %CAR+

**Bottom line:** %CAR+ is measured by the validated flow method FC-CAR (% of CD3+) and has a release/PPQ criterion of ≥20%. The process is controlled mainly through transduction MOI, which is the strongest driver in the data. PPQ passed comfortably (36–45%). The open issues are that the highest-RPN CAR risk (FM-06) has no assurance approach or CAR-specific test linked, the root cause of the low engineering runs is unresolved and probably mis-attributed, and an open change control (CC-26-022) would move MOI outside the validated range.

### 1. Definition and measurement
- **CQA:** %CAR+ (FC-CAR, % of CD3+), PPQ-001 criterion 8, ≥20%. Complementary CQAs are VCN per CAR+ cell (≤5 copies, criterion 9, ddPCR per URS-LIMS-004) and ID-CAR-PCR (positive).
- **Method:** AM-FC-CAR, flow cytometry, validated range 5–90% of CD3+. Validation protocol AMV-FC-CAR-01 (v1.0) is approved; its single test case TC-AMV-CAR-01 was executed as TX-0086 on 2026-03-20 (PASS, VAL-03/QA-02). The acceptance criterion is recorded only as "per ICH Q2(R2) protocol criteria", with no numeric limits.
- **In-process:** %CAR+ is also recorded on expansion day 5 (uo05 car_pos_pct), but only on that day.

### 2. Process parameters driving %CAR+
- **Transduction MOI** (CPP, 4.0–6.0 TU/cell, PPQ-001 criterion 1; enforced by hard stop URS-EBR-009 / CS-EBR-03; calculation URS-EBR-007 / CS-EBR-02; procedure SOP-MFG-104 v2.0). Observed FC-CAR by MOI, from DoE and platform runs:
  - MOI 2.5: 19.4 and 23.8%
  - MOI 5.0 (PV2.0, excluding ENG): about 35–45%
  - MOI 10: 64.8 and 68.2%
  - MOI 15: 76.3 and 77.1%
  - There are no data at MOI 4.0, the lower edge of the CPP range.
- Other CPPs: seeding density 0.4–0.6 ×10⁶/mL (crit 2), incubator temperature 36.5–37.5 °C (crit 3), culture duration 7–9 days (crit 4), activation-to-transduction time 20–30 h (crit 5).
- Upstream: CD3 selection program and purity (FM-02, URS-PRDG-002), wash loss at harvest (FM-12), vector storage (FM-07).

### 3. Risks threatening %CAR+ (RA-PFMEA-001 v2.0, 2026-04-28)
